proposals.expected_signal: If higher-order item-item and user-item semantics are underused by simpler propagation, a message-transform graph with a contrastive auxiliary on stochastically perturbed neighborhoods should improveN
proposals.failure_mode: Over-parameterized message transforms may overfit ML-1M or destabilize optimization, yielding weak gains over simpler graph baselines despite auxiliary agreement.
proposals.hypothesis: A structurally richer message-passing encoder can extract signal from multi-hop collaborative structure that latent-factor and light propagation models miss, and a contrastive auxiliary between independently edge-dropped graph views will regularize node embeddings enough to preserve full-sort ranking quality.
